test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33c2e0549825dd8355ab06d1c0ec8cb7c4a5a6250abdc052fe662035e038f3dd.png]
solution:
The figure that will come next in the following figure series is as shown below :

 
• Circle which is darken moves in anti-clockwise from one corner to other corner by one step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d157e1326f510de0ef24e3ee5cf82837ec7aa74353324095fa7cee0c8741365.png] 

 
• Rhombus which is darken moves in anti-clockwise.
 
• Figure 1 to figure 2 one darken rhombus moves 3 steps anti-clockwise and other darken rhombus is added.
 
• Figure 2 to figure 3 darken rhombus moves 3 steps anti-clockwise and other darken rhombus is removed.
 
• Figure 3 to figure 4 one darken rhombus moves 3 steps clockwise and other darken rhombus is added.
 
• Figure 4 to figure 5 darken rhombus moves 3 steps clockwise and other darken rhombus is removed as shown in figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b8da810e50f17019e1e9c598dcc9f4a74ad341b57c346adaa14cefd0ffd3521.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
